sn22.90:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
sn22.90:1.2: atha kho āyasmā channo sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito apāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihārena vihāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū etadavoca
sn22.90:1.3: ovadantu maṃ āyasmanto therā anusāsantu maṃ āyasmanto therā karontu me āyasmanto therā dhammiṃ kathaṃ yathāhaṃ dhammaṃ passeyyanti.
sn22.90:2.1: evaṃ vutte therā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ channaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn22.90:3.11: sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā sabbe dhammā anattāti
sn22.90:3.12: atha ca pana me sabbasaṅkhārasamathe sabbūpadhipaṭinissagge taṇhakkhaye virāge nirodhe nibbāne cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati
sn22.90:3.16: na kho panetaṃ dhammaṃ passato hoti
sn22.90:3.17: ko nu kho me tathā dhammaṃ deseyya yathāhaṃ dhammaṃ passeyyanti.
sn22.90:4.2: ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ pahoti ca me āyasmā ānando tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathāhaṃ dhammaṃ passeyyaṃ
sn22.90:4.3: atthi ca me āyasmante ānande tāvatikā vissaṭṭhi
sn22.90:4.5: atha kho āyasmā channo senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena kosambī ghositārāmo yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā channo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
sn22.90:5.1: ekamidāhaṃ āvuso ānanda samayaṃ bārāṇasiyaṃ viharāmi isipatane migadāye
sn22.90:5.2: atha khvāhaṃ āvuso sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito apāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihārena vihāraṃ
sn22.90:5.4: ovadantu maṃ āyasmanto therā anusāsantu maṃ āyasmanto therā karontu me āyasmanto therā dhammiṃ kathaṃ yathāhaṃ dhammaṃ passeyyanti.
sn22.90:5.5: evaṃ vutte maṃ āvuso therā bhikkhū etadavocuṃ
sn22.90:5.13: sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā sabbe dhammā anattāti.

sn22.90:6.9: atha ca pana me sabbasaṅkhārasamathe sabbūpadhipaṭinissagge taṇhakkhaye virāge nirodhe nibbāne cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati
sn22.90:6.13: na kho panetaṃ dhammaṃ passato hoti

sn22.90:7.2: ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ pahoti ca me āyasmā ānando tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathāhaṃ dhammaṃ passeyyaṃ
sn22.90:7.3: atthi ca āyasmante ānande tāvatikā vissaṭṭhi
sn22.90:7.7: karotu me āyasmā ānando dhammiṃ kathaṃ yathāhaṃ dhammaṃ passeyyanti.
sn22.90:8.1: ettakenapi mayaṃ āyasmato channassa attamanā abhiraddhā taṃ āyasmā channo āviakāsisi khīlaṃ pabhindi
sn22.90:8.4: atha kho āyasmato channassa tāvatakeneva uḷāraṃ pītipāmojjaṃ uppajji
sn22.90:9.1: sammukhā metaṃ āvuso channa bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ kaccānagottaṃ bhikkhuṃ ovadantassa
sn22.90:9.2: dvayanissito khvāyaṃ kaccāna loko yebhuyyena atthitañceva natthitañca.
sn22.90:9.3: lokasamudayaṃ kho kaccāna yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke natthitā sā na hoti.
sn22.90:9.4: lokanirodhaṃ kho kaccāna yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke atthitā sā na hoti.
sn22.90:9.6: tassa upāyupādānaṃ cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayaṃ na upeti na upādiyati na adhiṭṭhāti attā meti
sn22.90:9.7: dukkhameva uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati dukkhaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ nirujjhatīti na kaṅkhati na vicikicchati
sn22.90:9.12: ete te kaccāna ubho ante anupagamma majjhena tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti
sn22.90:10.1: evametaṃ āvuso ānanda hoti yesaṃ āyasmantānaṃ tādisā sabrahmacārayo anukampakā atthakāmā ovādakā anusāsakā
sn22.90:10.2: idañca pana me āyasmato ānandassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā dhammo abhisamitoti.
